worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.summary: A pair of psychic fangs closes in front of the user, reaching tick by tick until it bites the first thing it touches: a body is bitten for contact damage and any screen actually cleared at the closure (up to three layers) is devoured for extra force; a screen met first is swallowed alone, without reaching the body behind it. A wall stops the tips.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.use.0: Bite the first target from a step further out
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.use.1: Crush the screen in front of the mouth and devour it for force
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.use.2: Eat a barrier the moment it goes up
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.descripti: The bite deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block bite radius; only the frontmost body is bitten and those behind it are screened off.

The fangs reach up to %1$s blocks; Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil actually cleared at the closure count for up to three layers (cleanup radius %2$s blocks), and each cleared layer raises this bite's power by %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.devour.on: Devour mode: 1.7x per-layer bonus, 1.25x cleanup radius and 1.1x reach, at 0.9x base bite, +2 ticks windup and +8 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.devour.of: Pierce mode: 1.08x base bite and a quicker close, but a 0.6x per-layer bonus and the base cleanup radius.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s and the devour bonus to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.preferenc: On: 1.7x per-shattered-layer bonus, 1.25x cleanup radius and 1.1x reach, but 0.9x base bite, +2 ticks windup and +8 ticks cooldown. Off: 1.08x base bite and a 0.6x per-layer bonus.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of reaching out. Larger values start the bite from further away.
On: prefer a target carrying Reflect, Light Screen or Aurora Veil and swallow the barrier in front of the mouth for extra force. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.descripti: The pair of fangs closes only once, on the first body or barrier it meets: a screen met first is swallowed alone without reaching the body behind it, and an empty bite still clears the barrier it touches.
